game_title: Refactor Rescue – Buried Temple Steps Trial
game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps, steps of a half-buried temple: the camel trader must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Refactor Rescue: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior.
theme: Sand Dunes – Buried Temple Steps: steps of a half-buried temple
core_gameplay_loop: In Buried Temple Steps, repeat each round: Clean up messy duplicated code into tidy functions without changing its behavior. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the clean_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the camel pen using at most 22 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The camel pen reached with actions_used <= 22.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 22 before the camel pen is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Refactor Rescue
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how clean_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Buried Temple Steps.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The camel pen reached with actions_used <= 22.
